name: Ghost of an Ancient Railroad Engineer

default/32055.htm.text: Ghost of an Ancient Railraod Engineer: It's so cold... and i am so very tired. How long must I remain like this? Why haven't I gone mad like all the others? Why am i trapped here?
default/32055.htm.header: Ghost of an Ancient Railraod Engineer

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-01.h.text: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer: You can hear me? Truly? At last! It has been so long since anyone has been able to see or hear me. That gal over there - I've been calling to her for ages, and she doesn't even know I exist! I need your help. Please, please listen to what I ask.
Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-01.h.header: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-03.h.text: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer: Somewhere in this railroad station, I think there is a hammer with engravings on its handle . I think one of the railroad workers knows where it is.
Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-03.h.header: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-04.h.text: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer: Yes, that's it! That's the hammer! I have missed it so... I brought that hammer with me when I first set foot on this land. Would you please hand it to me?
Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-04.h.header: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-07.h.text: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer: I can move no more. Could you please go to the Trolley Ruins and meet my friend for me? I am too weak to go see him now. Please...a favor for an old, harmless ghost.
Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-07.h.header: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-02.h.text: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer: ...Hm? Ah, sorry, I forgot what I was saying. Don't be alarmed, I am a ghost. Oh, you can tell? Yes, I guess you could, come to think of it. The translucency and the echoing voice are, pardon the expression, dead giveaways. Well, I'm stuck in this place becau…
Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-02.h.header: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-05.h.text: (The hammer falls right through his hand onto the ground. It breaks with a thud.) Ghost of the Anciant Railroad Engineer: Oh, woe! I can't hold it! I can't hold it! I thought I could hold at least this hammer if nothing else! My own good hammer, and I have no hand to hold it... Well, there is nothi…

Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-06.h.text: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer: Where is my hammer? Did I drop it somewhere?
Q00117_TheOceanOfDistantStars/32055-06.h.header: Ghost of the Ancient Railroad Engineer
